g.text: At the flat bottom of the notch a small shift barely changes the power;

g.text: on the steep side it changes a lot — that is why the modulator is slightly detuned.

g.text: A · tune the filters to the target channel spacing (3.2 nm)

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: B · then tune each modulator to approximately align with its filter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: (1) laser wavelength at the peak of the filter

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: → minimizes loss and optical filtering of the data stream

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: (2) modulator resonance slightly detuned from the laser

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ff9f0a

g.text: Together (1) + (2) → the dip near the filter peak (panel 2)

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Caveat at 40 Gb/s: RF power dissipated on the ring modulator

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: drifts its resonance → modulator and laser needed fine re-alignment.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Takeaway: a well-tuned channel = laser on the filter peak + the dip beside it — the modulator resonance, slightly detuned to generate the desired extinction ratio.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Book Sec. 13.1.3 and Fig. 13.7 (p. 412). All curves are a schematic toy model computed for this figure (no numeric axes); only 3.2 nm and 0.8 nm (100 GHz) are book values.
